subject: FDA warns of hidden ingredients in some sleep, skin, and bodybuilding products
script: From Agewell Brief: FDA warns of hidden ingredients in some sleep, skin, and bodybuilding products. Some products marketed as dietary supplements or foods contain undeclared drugs. The FDA's searchable list can help you check. Hidden drug ingredients can appear in 'all natural' products. The FDA maintains a searchable notification list online. Check specific products before you buy or use them. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
